title: A novel and sustainable synthesis-functionalization strategy for the oxidative cyclization towards 2,5-disubstituted-1,3,4-oxadiazoles using bentonite-supported copper(I) iodide as a green catalyst
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,3765-3779
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09105E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Vinh Quang Tran, Dat Minh Tran, Minh Hai Tran, Phuong Hoang Tran, Hai Truong Nguyen
This study developed a novel, sustainable approach for synthesizing 2,5-disubstituted-1,3,4-oxadiazoles via oxidative cyclization of hydrazones using a heterogeneous bentonite-supported copper(I) iodide (CuI/Bent-NH2) as a catalyst.
